title: If you only drank energy drinks, how long until you die?

lines.text: If you drank nothing but energy drinks, how long until you die?
Day one. Eight cans. Your heart is doing a drum solo.
You can't sleep, so you drink more to stay awake.
The acid starts dissolving your tooth enamel.
Sugar free won't save you. It's still packed with caffeine and acid.
Then one night, all that caffeine scrambles your heartbeat. Mid game.
You died. Comment what stupid shenanigans Gary should try tomorrow.

experiment.premise: life change (paired with today's absurd events)
experiment.hook: cold open: slumped in a sea of cans; label ONLY ENERGY DRINKS? HOW LONG?
